snippet.title: Solasta II - Early Access Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Embark on a new adventure in Solasta II, the upcoming tactical RPG from Tactical Adventures. Set in the Mana-infused land of Neokos, this game brings deep strategy, rich storytelling, and the iconic dice-rolling mechanics of tabletop RPGs. Your choices matter as you lead a party of adventurers to face the enigmatic Shadwyn and uncover the secrets of this new continent.

Solasta II is slated for Early Access in early 2026. Stay tuned for more updates and join us on this journey into the world of Neokos.
